title: debug_replay reports 5 of the lane's 8 judges and its verdict reads 4: red judges pass unseen
claim: tools/replay/debug_replay.py:main prints offenders for finite, unit, no_default, agreement and cycle and grades smoke_verdict on four of them, while tests/replay.py:run_fixture returns and the lane grades eight (also not_frozen, away, cycle_cost): on the owner's window hours 7-9 not_frozen is red and never printed (unreported_red_judges=1), and on the 7-day synthetic null bundle agreement is red with 41 offenders while debug_replay prints smoke_verdict=pass (verdict_blind_red_judges=1).
mechanism: debug_replay.main hard-codes the tuple of judges it prints and a shorter tuple its verdict reads; run_fixture's results dict is the lane's (grade_ran checks every key empty). The D15 timeline replay is graded by debug_replay's report, so judges outside its tuples, and agreement for the verdict, never reach the D15 seat.

evidence.value: real chunk: lane_red_judges=2 (no_default, not_frozen), unreported_red_judges=1 (not_frozen); synthetic 7-day: lane_red_judges=1 (agreement 41), debug_replay_verdict=pass, verdict_blind_red_judges=1

instrumented_symbol: tools/replay/debug_replay.py:main (its printed and verdict judge tuples, read off its source by AST) over tests/replay.py:run_fixture's verdict

perturbation.change: --verdict-keys all: debug_replay's verdict reads every judge run_fixture returns (the lane's rule)

metric_definition: Judges red in run_fixture's verdict that debug_replay.main does not print (unreported) or its smoke_verdict does not read (verdict-blind).
phenomenon_property: The D15 timeline replay reports and grades every judge the replay lane grades (run_fixture's results keys), so a lane-red judge is never a debug_replay pass.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub:tests:custom_components python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D15/s2/m5_judges.py --bundle B --hours 1   # unreported_/verdict_blind_red_judges name the judges outside debug_replay.main's tuples

null_control.note: a chunk where no judge is red: the two definitions agree

proposed_fix_scope: tools/replay/debug_replay.py:main: print a RESULT per key of run_fixture's results and grade smoke_verdict on all of them (or on the lane's own grading), with a gate check that the printed set equals run_fixture's keys.
